title: Rating filter component audit
purpose: Audit rating as either its own filter type or an option-family variant before adding deeper controls.
objective: Classify rating, define anatomy, threshold behavior, icon/star strategy, states, responsive behavior, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: rating options, threshold semantics, star/icon/numeric labels, selected state, hover/focus/disabled states, classification decision, responsive behavior, and QA scenario. Out of scope: implementing rating controls and other filter types.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current rating render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A rating audit sheet exists with classification decision and controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: Rating is classified as own type or option-family variant.

phases.title: Classification
phases.purpose: Decide own type vs option-family variant.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source changes are made.
